title: Safeguarding
metaDescription: Safeguarding information, policy access, and key contacts for St John's Park Church.

sections.title: Safeguarding
sections.contentHtml:
St John's Park is committed to high standards in the safeguarding and care of children and vulnerable adults across all areas of church life.

If you need to speak to someone locally, please contact Claire Smith, our safeguarding officer, at safeguarding@saintjohnspark.org.

You can download our current safeguarding policy here: St John's Safeguarding Policy 2025 (DOCX).

The Diocese of Sheffield's Safeguarding Adviser is Siân Checkley. Contact 01709 309100 or 07741 013775, or email sian.checkley@sheffield.anglican.org. More diocesan safeguarding information is available at sheffield.anglican.org/support/safeguarding.
